title: Gchair
award: Honorable Mention, 2007 National Creative Furniture Design Competition
summary: Inspired by the treble clef, this design translates musical rhythm into form, making furniture a melody within a space.

title: Water’s Echo in Wood
award: Selected, 2008 Taiwan International Wood Sculpture Competition
summary: A sound of water, ripples unfolding — seeking a fleeting stir within, holding, for a moment, its resonance.

title: Seen Through
title_zh: 透明公廁的環境知覺調查
summary: A phone-based study of Shigeru Ban's transparent public toilet in Haru-no-Ogawa Community Park, Tokyo. Participants pick a booth and live through four visual boundaries in it: always opaque, always frosted, frosted on locking (the real design) and always clear. They rate privacy and safety before entering and after locking, and answers go straight to Google Sheets. The project page explains the method and lists its references.

title: Architecture App
title_zh: 與 AI 協作的網站與專題導覽
summary: How this website and the Seen Through final project were made with AI: full scripts in Chinese and English, before-and-after comparisons, diagrams and a one-page A4 handout.

title: Zhongli Shrine, Then and Now
title_zh: 中壢神社 古今對照
summary: The Zhongli Shrine (1939) once stood where Zhongli Senior High School is today. The reconstructed shrine stands on today's aerial photo; a slider fades it away to show the campus beneath, and a short tour lines up an old photograph with the model.

title: Telescope Lab
summary: A browser-based 3D Dobsonian telescope for high school astronomy lessons. Students work through six steps from the worksheet “How to Use a Telescope”: take off the cap, fit the eyepiece, find the sign across the courtyard, focus, see the inverted image and align the finder. Each step is checked as it is done, and the panel folds away to leave the telescope in view.

title: clhs4bar
summary: A four-bar linkage dressed as a horse, made for a high school mechanism lesson. Students change the four bar lengths in the browser, watch whether the crank can still turn, then print a 1:1 sheet to draw and cut their own figure.

title: Ruisui Fire Station Green Retrofit
title_zh: 瑞穗消防分隊 綠建築改善前後比較
summary: A midterm study for the course Green Building Development Practice. One 3D model of a three-storey fire station in Hualien's East Rift Valley compares passive design (sun, planting, daylight, ventilation, shading) and active systems (walls, roof, glazing, lighting, air conditioning, rainwater) before and after a retrofit. It switches between colour, plain and night views, and the same page plays as a slide deck.
